hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has a separate entry for Wemba Wemba [xww]. But Wemba Wemba [xww] belongs to a large set of named varieties close enough to be the same language which may be called Western Victoria (**hh:hw:Hercus:Victoria:1969**, **hh:d:Hercus:Wembawemba**, **hh:hvw:Waferetal:New-South-Wales**).
See also: Warrnambool [gjm], Western Victoria [NOCODE_Western-Victoria], Woiwurrung [wyi].
